[[Governor/Legends|Governor]] '''Kraxith''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who ruled the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trebela]]. He broke the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cell network in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] and was surprised to see the extent of the Alliance operation.<ref name="SWS" />
